name: Colombo
desc: Colonial streets, rooftop bars and a buzzing food scene by the Indian Ocean.

name: Sigiriya
desc: Climb the 5th-century rock fortress rising from the jungle plain.

name: Kandy
wiki: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic|Esala Perahera|Kandy
desc: The sacred Temple of the Tooth beside a misty highland lake.

name: Ella
desc: Rolling tea estates, hiking trails and the famous Nine Arch Bridge.

name: Nuwara Eliya
desc: Cool colonial-era hill town wrapped in emerald tea plantations.

name: Yala
desc: Sri Lanka's top national park — leopards, elephants and even sloth bears.

name: Mirissa
desc: A crescent beach town famous for whale watching and easy surf.

name: Galle
desc: A 16th-century Dutch fort city of ramparts, cafes and boutique stays.

name: Trincomalee
desc: Turquoise bays, quiet beaches and some of the island's best diving.

name: Anuradhapura
desc: Sprawling ruins of Sri Lanka's first great kingdom, over 2,000 years old.

name: Dambulla
desc: A 2,000-year-old cave temple complex of painted ceilings and gilded Buddhas.

name: Polonnaruwa
desc: Sri Lanka's medieval capital — remarkably intact temples, stupas and stone carvings.

name: Wilpattu
desc: The island's largest national park, known for leopards around its natural lakes.

name: Minneriya
desc: Home of "The Gathering" — hundreds of wild elephants converge on the reservoir.

name: Arugam Bay
desc: Sri Lanka's legendary surf town, laid-back and lined with point breaks.

name: Kataragama
desc: A multi-faith pilgrimage town revered by Buddhists, Hindus and Muslims alike.

name: Belihul Oya
desc: A quiet river valley in the hill country, ideal for waterfalls and forest walks.

name: Jaffna
desc: A distinct Tamil heartland of lagoons, palmyra palms and centuries-old temples.

name: Kalpitiya
desc: A wild, windswept peninsula famous for kitesurfing and dolphin pods.

name: Hikkaduwa
desc: A laid-back reef town for snorkelling, surf breaks and beachfront cafes.
